summary: @servicetitan/datadog-rum preinstall downloads Bun and executes obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: The package advertises itself as a DataDog RUM SDK wrapper, but ships a `preinstall` lifecycle script (`node setup.mjs`) whose sole purpose is to fetch the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory, mark it executable, and invoke it against `math_init.js` — a single-line, ~727 KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle shipped at the package root. `math_init.js` uses string-array rotation obfuscation (`_0x`-style identifiers, a large character lookup table, and a shifter function), contains no human-readable strings and no source map, and has no relationship to the package's advertised DataDog RUM functionality. `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with the same style wrapper around straightforward logic (musl detection, HTTP GET with redirect handling, ZIP extraction via `unzip` / PowerShell `Expand-Archive` / inline zlib), and falls back to invoking a pre-existing `bun` on PATH if one is present. The runtime download plus alternate-runtime execution of an opaque payload happens automatically on `npm install`, running with the installer's user privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
